thread:
claire: Quick audit result 1: found 22 markdown pages referencing /v1 endpoints, several SDK snippets using renamed params. Need quick triage before we flip the deprecation banner.

anika: can you paste the list?

claire: uploaded CSV to the doc tracker: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4999. Categories: quickstarts, examples, customer guides, and 3 API reference pages.

samir: which param rename is the worst offender?

claire: `include_metadata` -> `meta` in both python & node snippets; node streaming examples also still use old `frame` semantics.

matt: recommendation: patch the code samples directly, add brief compatibility notes where behavioral differences exist, and only add redirects for externally-linked guide pages.

anika: agree. ops-bot, can infra accept a small redirect CSV for externally-linked pages?

ops-bot: yes. Add entries to infra/redirects/1759999999.csv. Ops can deploy once PR is merged; rollout ETA ~15m.

docs-bot: running quick link-and-snippet lint. Results: 22 link failures, 11 snippet param matches. Full report: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/link-scan-1759999999.html

samir: i'll open PRs for snippets: #710 (python quickstart), #711 (node streaming), #712 (embeddings examples). Each will include a CI smoke test.

anika: add checklist to each PR: compile/run snippet, update crosslinks, and note if redirected.

claire: i'll compile CSV with old_path,new_path,reason,owner and drop into infra/redirects.

matt: small note: where streaming framing differs, leave a note rather than a silent swap. Customers need to be aware.

anika: good. timeline: aim to merge PRs within 24h and deploy redirects before the banner goes live.

ops-bot: redirect CSV path reserved: infra/redirects/1759999999.csv.

samir: PRs opened and linked in tracker. Will ping when CI green.

anika: thanks team. After redirects live we'll run post-deploy smoke: 1) try old external URLs, 2) run python quickstart snippet, 3) verify model alias mapping in guides. Jordan, can you own the smoke job?

jordan: I can take it, but i'm OOO in the morning. matt can you step in?

matt: yes I got it.

docs-bot: archive note: thread linked to issue #4999-migration-audit (auto).
